desc: The Frankford Arsenal Intellidropper is the most advanced, intelligent and precise electronic powder measure on the market today. The Intellidropper features a proprietary powder calibration button for fast and accurate powder measurements. Auto and manual trickle capability maintain up to 250 grains of powder per throw. Holds more than 7,000gr (1lb) of powder and offers +/- 0.1 grain accuracy. The Intellidropper dispenses powder two-times faster than other powder measures on the market. Frankford Arsenal's Intellidropper mobile app makes reloading your ammunition easier than ever.
